extension.news: [B]1.2.4[/B][CR]- Skin settings no longer show rows that cannot do anything. Switch a home menu item off and its "Edit widgets" and "Default select action" rows now disappear instead of sitting there greyed out. Movies, TV shows, Music, Music videos, TV, Radio and Add-ons all behave this way.[CR]- Turn off "Show media fanart as background" and the three fanart pack pickers go with it. Turn off the video OSD autoclose and its seconds row goes too.[CR]- "Choose genre fanart pack" was worse than greyed out. With fanart switched off it stayed fully clickable and picking a pack did nothing at all. It now hides alongside the other two pickers.[CR]- The virtual keyboard suggests words as you type. Kodi installs the AutoCompletion add-on together with the skin, on an update as well as on a fresh install, so the suggestion strip above the keyboard is no longer permanently empty.[CR]- Groundwork with no visible effect: this release marks profiles that already run the skin as arranged by their owner, so that a later release can lay out a default home menu on brand new installs only, and can never rearrange a box that is already set up the way you want it.[CR][CR][B]1.2.3[/B][CR]- "Number of items to show in home screen lists" now applies to every home row. The Movies and TV shows poster rows already followed it. The Music, Music videos, Add-ons, Games, TV and Radio rows were fixed at 15 and no setting could move them.[CR]- The live TV and radio rows that carried no limit at all were rendering their whole directory instead of a row. On a Fire TV with the setting at 5, the TV channel groups row held all 12 groups while the poster rows held 5.[CR]- The random music video artists row was pinned to 10 and now follows the setting like the rest.[CR]- The Categories rows stay at 20 on purpose. They are navigation rather than content, so shrinking them would remove entries such as Playlists and Add-ons.[CR]- The setting takes effect without restarting Kodi, a few seconds after the row is next on screen.[CR][CR][B]1.2.2[/B][CR]- Apple TV only: POV, Multi Weather and EZ Maintenance++ work again. Kodi 22's Apple TV build ships a Python with a piece missing that every add-on fetching over the internet needs, so those add-ons failed the moment they started. The skin puts that piece back on every start, and puts it back again if an add-on update removes it.[CR]- Apple TV only: the Siri remote no longer opens the Favourites window when you back out of a video, and back in fullscreen returns to the menu with playback continuing instead of stopping it. Double play/pause goes back into fullscreen, and select opens the OSD on live TV.[CR]- No change on Fire TV, Android or desktop.[CR][CR][B]1.2.1[/B][CR]- POV is now a real install dependency, so Kodi pulls it in with the skin instead of leaving the Movies and TV shows rows empty on a box that does not have it.[CR]- Skin details rewritten to describe this skin rather than stock Estuary.[CR][CR][B]1.2.0[/B][CR]- Movies and TV shows home tabs are driven by POV rather than the local library, with per-row toggles in skin settings.[CR]- Main-menu items and search open POV directly.[CR]- Rounded poster treatment ported from Estuary 8.[CR]- Trimmed 1.9 MB of unreachable payload out of the package.
extension.summary: Estuary with the Movies and TV shows tabs driven by POV.
extension.description: Estuary POV is Kodi's stock Estuary with its Movies and TV shows home tabs rebuilt around the POV add-on instead of the local video library. Trending, popular, premieres, upcoming, in progress and watched rows all come from POV, each row can be switched off individually in skin settings, and the main-menu items and search open POV directly. Posters carry the rounded treatment from Estuary 8. Requires Kodi 22 (Piers) and the POV add-on.
extension.disclaimer: The Movies and TV shows tabs need the POV add-on. Kodi installs it with the skin.
